verdict.rationale: Ardent documents unlimited branches per database that scale to zero, don't duplicate storage, and bill only for active compute, which supports cheap per-agent and per-PR/preview isolated Postgres databases. Fleet management is programmatic through a CLI with JSON output, token auth, stable error codes and idempotent creates, plus a REST API aimed at agent workflows. missing for 10: evidence of operating at thousands-of-branches scale, a per-tenant production database model (branches are copies of a source database, not fresh tenant DBs), a published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of cost and scale.
